limits: Needs the network; the protein leaves the machine.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Relays the remote service's own result unchanged; it computes no number of its own, so the service is the authority for what comes back.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which conserved domains does NCBI's CD-Search find in this protein?

description: RPS-BLAST a protein against NCBI's Conserved Domain Database (CDD) or one of its member collections (Pfam, SMART, COG, KOG, PRK, TIGR, NCBI-curated), through NCBI Batch CD-Search. Returns every domain hit with its hit type (specific, non-specific, superfamily, multi-domain), residue span, E-value, bit score, CDD accession, superfamily cluster and whether the alignment stops short of either end of the model. This is the rpsblast program. Give `protein`, or give `dna` to send its six reading frames as six proteins (per-frame CD-Search: each E-value is for its own frame, which is not rpstblastn; rpstblastn_smart runs rpstblastn itself on this machine). The query leaves the machine for NCBI.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

compbasedadj.description: 0 no composition-based statistics · 1 composition-based statistics · 2 composition matrix adjust · 3 forced full matrix adjust.

db.description: the PSSM collection, as the live Batch CD-Search form names it (cdd, cdd_ncbi, oasis_pfam, oasis_smart …); live mode only. Only applies when smode is live.

dmode.description: which hits come back: concise (the best hit per region), standard (the best per source database per region) or full (every hit). Values: rep (concise), std (standard), full (full).

dna.description: instead of `protein`: DNA whose six reading frames are sent as six proteins, labeled frame +1 … frame -3; each hit names its frame in queryLabel.

evalue.description: E-value cutoff; live mode only (automatic and precomputed apply 0.01). Only applies when smode is live.

filter.description: mask low-complexity regions of the query before searching.

maxhit.description: most hits per protein; live mode only (automatic and precomputed apply 500). Only applies when smode is live.

protein.description: the protein sequence, one-letter codes; wire it from translate_sequence or read it off a CDS.

smode.description: NCBI's search mode: automatic uses precomputed results where they exist, precomputed never runs a search, live always runs one. Only live honours db, evalue and maxhit. Values: auto (automatic), prec (precomputed only), live (live search).

name: rps_blast_cdd

cdsid.description: NCBI's search id, re-openable in CD-Search's own viewer for two days

hits.description: every domain hit: queryLabel (the frame, for a `dna` query), hitType, pssmId, from, to (1-based residues), evalue, bitscore, accession, shortName, incompleteN, incompleteC, superfamily, definition
